newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds struggle at 99.78, downside pulls.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds struggle at 99.78, downside pulls.

text.p: June Bund futures, under pressure from falls in U.S. markets on Friday, will struggle to stay above support at 99.78 this session, technical analysts said on Monday.
If that level evaporates, the market will find a strong buffer around the 99.50 area, they said.
"Bunds are going to have a hard time not heading lower," Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London.
Bunds were quoted at 99.81 at 0651 GMT, up 0.01 from Friday, after dipping to a low of 99.76 early on.
Celaya said the market would find solid support around the the March 20 low of 99.52.
"Once we're below there, it's going to be opening up 99.00 which is massive support and 99.05, the low for April," he said, citing the market's April 3 low.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, saw support between those two levels at around 99.30, which equated with a six percent yield on 10-year cash Bunds.
"In Germany we've seen a mild recovery," Hobson said on Reuters Financial Television.
Celaya said the area the market needed to break on the upside was clustered around par -- 99.95 to 100.05. Bunds put in a low of 100.02 on April 10 and a 99.98 low on March 26.
"After that you don't have too much until 100.15,20,28 -- old gaps, lows and highs," Celeya said.
"We think the recovery has now failed at this key 100.62 level," he said. June Bunds touched a 100.66 high on April 9 before retreating.
June Euromarks were quoted at 96.73, unchanged from Friday.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said there was evidence the market was failing around strong resistance at 96.75.

He said in a research note an overbought stochastic indicator was now falling and giving a fesh sell signal and an end to the corrective rally. He set downside targets around the old low of 96.75 on March 18.
